owner_intent: The project must proactively remember the small details that make the world feel alive; the owner should not have to remember to request every sound, motion, reaction or environmental behavior.
truth_boundary: Completeness and production contract. 103/103 registered scripted VO cues now have generated external MP3 sources, but WAV mastering, UE import/playback, lip-sync, PIE/device/mix acceptance and non-scripted living-world audio coverage remain separate evidence.

voice_and_character_performance: gesture, posture, body-weight and reaction timing
footsteps_and_physical_foley: surface-driven footsteps: grass, dirt, gravel, mud, stone, wood, snow, shallow water, foliage where applicable
weapon handling, quiver, armor, bags, belts
cutlery, crockery, bottles, books, paper, tools
carts, wheels, harness, ropes, chains, paddles
society_and_npc_life: farm, market, craft, inn and festival activity
alert, warn, flee, hide, assist, guard responses
aftermath repair, clean, tend wounded, mourn, celebrate, relocate
population density changes by story state
age/clothing/prop/idle/route variation instead of clone crowds
wildlife_and_creatures: birds, insects and small animals as lightweight biome-specific systems
horses/ponies/farm animals with movement, vocalization and panic response
larger fauna only where canon/biome/gameplay supports it
creature breathing, locomotion, vocals, impacts and threat distance cues
vegetation_weather_water: trees, leaves, hedges and grass react to region-appropriate wind
rain, snow, storm and wind linked to soundscape/state
streams, rivers, waterfalls, splashes, paddles and wet-bank response
insects/distant fauna by biome/time where appropriate
intentional stillness/silence in dead or threat-heavy regions
environmental_audio: spatial spot ambience with randomized timing and anti-repetition
voice priority and ducking for intelligibility
world_props_and_activity: fireplaces, braziers, furnaces and flame response
banners, ropes, signs, cloth, mechanisms and clutter motion where appropriate
interactive props produce both visible response and readable sound
combat_and_threat: battle crowds, horns, siege and impact families when authored
gameplay readability takes priority over constant loudness
world_state_and_memory: weather and danger influence NPC behavior
named NPC dialogue respects memory, relationship and knowledge limits
committed visible-world identity owns NPC mood/context during async swaps
save/load restores persistent state without duplicate authority
accessibility_and_presentation: cinematics preserve dialogue readability and return cleanly to gameplay

performance_architecture.target: i7 6th gen, 8GB RAM, approximately 2GB VRAM, DX11, 720p Low-Medium
rules: Believability comes from authored routines + relevance-aware systems, not maximum simulation.
Crowd NPCs use pooling; avoid high-frequency Spawn/Destroy churn.
Repeated world detail uses ISM/HISM and explicit culling where appropriate.
Heavy assets use soft references and asynchronous FStreamableManager loading.
Background NPC/wildlife fidelity scales by distance/relevance/visibility.
Bound concurrent voices, fauna, foley and spot ambience; measure before raising density.
Do not invent universal numeric budgets without target-device profiling.

mandatory_focus: birds, hedge breeze, farm animals, carts and distant laughter
Bag End warm room tone, fireplace, wood, cutlery and household foley
natural gaze/gesture/lip-sync once production rigs exist
current_evidence: 25/25 scripted P1C01 VO cues generated externally and registered.
No WAV master, UE import or real playback evidence yet.
Non-scripted audio/life layers remain to source/generate and register.

chapter_completion_rule: No chapter may be treated as experientially complete while an applicable mandatory layer is silently omitted. Each layer must be explicitly READY, PARTIAL, BLOCKED or N_A with evidence.
execution_boundary: Offline-safe generation, sourcing, license/provenance verification, manifests and production preparation proceed now on isolated branches. Runtime integration and acceptance remain W00/runner-gated. The owner is not responsible for enumerating micro-details; missing layers are surfaced by LivingWorldMasterCoverageMapV1.
